reason: Unbounded linear edits spill factual fragments into other stories. Bound each semantic association with a pair of existing SwiGLU units. Same-token factual states are not negative examples of each other.
prototype_rule: Use grouped contexts when separated; fall back to individually separated states only for rejected groups.
formula: gate_a=beta*(d-t0*c), gate_b=beta*(d-t1*c), up_a=up_b=c. Bounded feature F=(SiLU(gate_a*x)-SiLU(gate_b*x))*(c*x)/(beta*(t1-t0)). Output values D=Vt*pinv(F)t. Preserve the original contribution of reassigned neurons on native inference states by a declared linear redistribution into the unchanged remaining neuron activations.
storage_precision: F32 changed tensors; F32 inference for both original and candidate
positive_labels: Only the previously declared short factual units; no complete corrected responses and no programmed EOS.
